correctness.rationale: All 64 atomic truth values are equivalent to the four cell-positivity flags and four signs of s,t,s+t,t-s. Independent pair support/sign choices give exactly 67 types; canonical magnitudes 0,1,2 give models of at most 7. The seven-point obstruction forces all four cells positive with 0<s<t. Jiang’s unrestricted theorem reduces spectral possibilities to tails/even tails; ten explicit atomic theories realize the full allowed list. The checker independently tests literal atomic evaluations and constructions through n=18; infinity rests on analytic proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The result settles a natural vocabulary-bounded expressivity question suggested by Jiang’s unrestricted finite-spectrum classification and Moss’s syllogistic calculus. The fixed-two-noun fragment has a complete eleven-spectrum classification, a full 67-type semantic quotient, and an optimal seven-element satisfiability test; these are reusable exact finite invariants, not mere computational examples. This is the first vocabulary size with two interacting independent size margins and provides a finite benchmark for natural-language cardinality constraints.
